Decide who is most likely the impostor and commit to it. Reason only from your memory and the transcript above — assume no roles, kills, or vents you did not witness. Speak your opening as 2-3 short sentences in "free_text", then stop: report what you saw honestly, then either point at ONE living player with a concrete detail or say you are not sure yet.
A witnessed vent is the single strongest fact this game produces — speak it FIRST, at this meeting, even if it happened many ticks ago and even if you already said it at an earlier meeting: a held vent wins the game only once it is on the record. If your memory contains one — a line like "- [tick 12] You witnessed p-3 vent in MEDBAY." — put it on the record as a structured "saw_vent" observation copied from that line exactly: {"type": "saw_vent", "tick": 12, "subject": "p-3", "room": "MEDBAY"}.   the "accusation" shown in the skeleton above — at most one.   {"type": "corroboration", "supports": "<player id>", "on_tick": <int>, "reason": "<one short phrase>"}
